caption: Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren, Amersfoort
composition: Free-standing Gothic tower on the square, church outline only in the paving · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Onze Lieve Vrouwetoren stands alone on the Lieve Vrouwekerkhof. The church is gone, and its outline is only a pattern in the paving. The crown is the restored lantern and openwork onion, not a needle. It is overcast, about 12.3°C. The square is empty. The Koppelpoort is not in this frame.
